briefing: The quota stands, commander. Pirates hold the lane our shipment must cross, and the collective needs it clear.
Clear the lane, recover the surveyor's pod, and land the survivor alive. From there, carry the manifest onward, and the collective's contract closes.
This is {PATRON}, planning director at {HERE}. The collective states each term once, and confirms only that a contract stands fulfilled.
dossier.lead: A tight-band signal from {PATRON} at {WORLD} says the collective wants a word.

rumour.far: Bulletin boards near {WORLD} say {PATRON} still needs a lane cleared for the collective's quota.
rumour.near: {PATRON} sends word from {WORLD}: the collective's quota still waits on that lane.

dossier.news: {PATRON} confirms the collective at {WORLD} still needs pilots for its quota work.
dossier.title: The Vetitice Quota

lane.arrive: Fly the lane to {TARGET} through whatever waits, and dock, for {PAY}
lane.success: The lane opened, and {TARGET} took the shipment through for {PAY}
lane.fail: The lane held the pirates, and the shipment never reached {TARGET}

pod.arrive: Scoop the surveyor's pod at {TARGET}, and land the survivor alive, for {PAY}
pod.success: The pod business at {TARGET} closes, and the collective's contract holds for {PAY}
pod.fail: The pod business at {TARGET} fails, and the contract lapses

route.arrive: Bring the surveyor's route back to {TARGET}, and dock, for {PAY}
route.success: The route reached {TARGET}, and the collective banks {PAY}
route.fail: The route never reached {TARGET}, and the contract lapses

manifest.arrive: Deliver the manifest to {TARGET}, and dock, for {PAY}
manifest.success: The manifest reached {TARGET}, and the collective pays {PAY}
manifest.fail: The manifest never reached {TARGET}, and the quota fails

story.opening: The commander took the collective's contract at {WORLD} on day {DAY}.

closing.complete: The collective's manifest reached its stop, and the contract closed at {WORLD} on day {DAY}.
closing.fail: The collective's contract lapsed, and it ended at {WORLD} on day {DAY}.

lane.success: The lane opened, and the shipment passed through to {WORLD} on day {DAY}.
lane.failed: The lane held the pirates, and the shipment never reached {WORLD} by day {DAY}.

pod.survivor:landed: The survivor was landed alive at {WORLD} on day {DAY}.
pod.survivor:sold: The survivor was sold, and the collective's contract lapsed on day {DAY}.
pod.targetDestroyed: The pod was destroyed before the scoop, and the run turned back toward {WORLD} on day {DAY}.
pod.failed: The pod was never reached, and the contract lapsed by day {DAY}.

route.success: The route closed at {WORLD} on day {DAY}.
route.failed: The route never closed, and the contract lapsed by day {DAY}.

manifest.success: The manifest reached {WORLD}, and the collective's quota closed on day {DAY}.
manifest.failed: The manifest never reached {WORLD}, and the quota went unmet by day {DAY}.
